free_tier.stated: 10MB limit for each attachment (there is no total limit for storage, just a per-file limit)
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: 10MB limit for each attachment; no total storage limit.

retention.stated: Deleting an attachment permanently removes the file from Amazon S3; deleting a card also deletes its attached files.
retention.notes: Deleting an attachment permanently removes the file from Amazon S3; deleting a card also deletes its attached files.

egress.terms: Uploaded attachments require user authorization to display; attachments and previews on public boards remain accessible without an account.

tooling: documented Trello REST API: POST /1/cards/{id}/attachments (multipart file or url), plus GET /1/cards/{id}/attachments; py-trello and trello-rclone-style wrappers exist
chaining: Free plan: up to 10 open boards and up to 10 Collaborators; 10MB per attachment with no total storage limit.
limits_note: 10 MB/file on Free; per-board attachment ceiling exists in the API response model (limits.attachments.perBoard warnAt 32400 / disableAt 36000). I.e. ~32k attachments/board before hard stop; 10 MB is small for bulk data.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the plan page states no registration requirement

reliability_note: attachments are real copies inside Trello ('Attachments from your computer create an actual copy within Trello'); Atlassian has deprecated/changed API auth (key+token still works) but attachments have been stable for a decade
confidence_note: the support.atlassian.com plan page states a 10MB limit for each attachment with no total storage limit
